'''Jin-Olori''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who served the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] as a vendor during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]]. She was of average height for a Human and had light, tan skin.
